_comment: Announcer lines for the 'my health is my inventory' challenge. 'major' lines always play; minor ones share a 5 second cooldown so the System doesn't talk over itself. Rebuild with: python3 tools/make_announcer.py

lines: Attention, player! New rule just dropped. Your hearts are now your inventory. Ten hearts, ten slots. Lose a heart, lose a slot. Lose them all, and, well. Let's not spoil the ending. Good luck. You will need it.
Ouch. That heart was holding a slot. Not anymore.
Slot confiscated. Please keep your hands inside the inventory at all times.
Another heart, another slot. At this rate you'll be carrying everything in your pockets. Oh, wait. You don't have pockets.
And there goes your stuff. Onto the floor. Where it lives now.
Butterfingers! Something just fell out of your inventory.
Item dropped. The ground thanks you for your generous donation.
Heart restored! One slot returned. Try not to lose it immediately.
Look at you, healing! Your inventory grows. I'm almost proud.
A slot has been returned. Please treat it better than the last one.
Warning! One heart. One slot. One very nervous player.
You are down to a single slot. Choose wisely. Maybe not the dirt.
Gravity: one. You: zero.
Fun fact! The ground does not move out of the way.
That was a long way down. Your inventory felt every block of it.
You are on fire. This is not a suggestion. It is a status update.
Hot tip: lava is not a hot tub.
Things are heating up! Mostly you.
That creeper just wanted a hug. A very, very loud hug.
Kaboom! Your inventory has been rearranged. Mostly onto the floor.
Explosion detected. Have you tried not standing next to it?
Diamonds! Shiny! Now, whatever you do, do not get hit.
Welcome to the Nether! Everything here wants to set you on fire. Please enjoy your stay.
Welcome to the End! One giant dragon versus one tiny inventory. I like these odds. For the dragon.
And the player has fallen! Inventory size: zero. Pride: also zero. Let's go again!
Oh no. Oh no, no, no. Well. That happened. Respawning one very embarrassed player.
System message: you have died. Please collect your belongings. All of them. From the floor.
Unbelievable! The dragon is down! Beaten with an inventory the size of a lunchbox. System message: you are a legend!
